edinburgh_lastdrop_waitress.text: Pull up a chair! Tea, scones and a history lesson, free with every order.
The Grassmarket was Edinburgh's market square for centuries. Cattle, horses and grain were traded right outside this window.
Look up from the door and the Castle fills the sky. The Grassmarket sits in the hollow right underneath the rock.

edinburgh_lastdrop_regular.text: Nowadays the market is cafes, shops and buskers. Trade still happens here. It just smells less of cattle.

edinburgh_quizmaster.text: Welcome to the Grassmarket quiz. The Last Drop is named for a hanging, so no pressure, but I do take a dim view of cheating.
Five questions. Whispering is allowed. Whispering the answer to the next table is a hanging offence. Metaphorically. Mostly.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: No bother. The tea room will keep the seat warm.
